oracle: Only the 30 preselected, visually reviewed TRAIN instances are allowed for weak fit. Canonical category-level queries, not official navigation/attributes: body pillow maps to pillow, multi person sofa to sofa, teatable to coffee table, cabinet generic includes display cabinet for negative exclusion. Do not use pose/OBB/crop as input. Pooled frames deduplicated by SHA, at most three per reviewed instance from different route where possible, at least four sampled decisions apart per route. Choosing train sample count does not inspect prediction outputs.
independent_dev: Frozen human-labeled historical 5 images, 10 object query statements and 5 native/synthetic negative controls (negative repeated per image for paired evaluation). Exclude the handle if claiming whole objects; additionally show all entries and instructions linguistic provenance. Two frozen 839934 mirror pairs are reported separately: for presence both real/mirror have same answer, and no new independent targets. Never tune on dev.
contrast: Training positive must be accompanied by at least one geometric negative in SAME image, with the negative class elsewhere selected as a seen positive class. Generate reverse-balanced positive/negative class edges if possible. Independent class-balanced core uses only pairs A/B with separate frames containing A and B, each frame with counterpart negative; class-only and image-only controls tie exactly by construction. Include historical five-frame test plus a transfer diagnostic if core/eval limited. Only full RGB inputs, letterbox and fixed 2x2 overlapping tiles; normalized cosine against frozen CLIP-ViT-B/32 text template. Fit 2-feature L2 logistic (raw full cosine and max tile cosine) with standardized train data, L2=1. Baseline full-only cosine with train calibration, compare paired direction and fixed classification. No hyperparameter selection or other model updates. Historical test uses single image full query category from human-annotated target; full native sentence semantics/closed-loop search untested.
